summary: Master Matterport, AR staging, and 3D digital twins. Learn to accelerate property sales and engagement with immersive technology. Enroll today.
lede: Immersive property technology combines 3D walkthroughs with augmented-reality overlays to present existing spaces and visualize unbuilt developments. For property marketers, developers and leasing professionals, the course covers spatial data capture, interactive digital twins with feature hotspots, AR furniture staging and WebXR tour deployment, including ways to optimize 3D assets for browser viewing.
audienceIntro: This course is essential for professionals responsible for property marketing, development visualization, and digital asset management who seek to leverage immersive technology for competitive advantage.
modules: Immersive Real Estate Ecosystem and Trends
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of real estate marketing principles and basic proficiency with digital photography or mobile imaging. Experience with property listing platforms or CRM systems is beneficial. No prior coding or 3D modeling experience is required, though familiarity with mobile apps and cloud-based software is expected.
